tasks.short: Recommend valid tests and test conditions

steps.what: Recommend tests and testing conditions by assessing design intent, customer requirements and applicable standards

tasks.design: Keep test selection and validity judgement with the technician under engineering direction, using controlled references in {DOCS}. The result is a recommendation with stated limits, rather than an automatic declaration that a test proves the design.
tasks.previous_blocker: Validity depends on whether the test represents the actual requirement and operating context.
tasks.enabler_now: The digest's recording and reporting tools do not establish automatic selection of valid automotive tests.
tasks.still_hard: Recognising inappropriate conditions, omitted failure modes and conflicting requirement interpretations.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can challenge a test that is repeatable but does not answer the engineering question.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in recommendation responsibility or final test approval.

reach.task: Explain why proposed conditions address the design question

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: recommending valid test conditions requires interpretation of requirements and context; no task-specific labour saving is established by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's recommendation, excluding test execution, formal engineering approval and preparation of a separate test report.

The technician identifies requirement and standard revisions, test article configuration, intended conditions, measured outcomes, acceptance basis and validity concerns during s1. Capture and interpretation are fully counted.
No free structured applicable-standard, valid-test or complete-coverage flag is assumed. Missing context or disputed applicability requires manual engineering clarification.
Use existing native reference and planning tools first. No new rule library, integration or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Test types and actual approval boundaries
Whether repetitive reference lookup is a separate significant burden
research_questions: Can a sample of recommendations isolate repeatable retrieval from substantive validity judgement?

already_counted.description: Interpret requirements and recommend tests with validity limits

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. An established test method and a novel operating condition both retain full applicability and validity assessment time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Research and test computerized automotive applications

steps.what: Define the research or testing approach for the computerized automotive application and its configuration
Participate in application research or testing, observing behaviour and investigating unexpected results

tasks.design: Retain investigation planning and participation with the technician, using the automotive test environment in {OTHER} and references in {DOCS}. Existing test automation remains a tool; its runtime does not establish a new reduction in research, setup or observation effort.
tasks.previous_blocker: Emerging applications present unfamiliar behaviour and system interactions that must be investigated.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied digest does not demonstrate autonomous research or test participation for these automotive applications.
tasks.still_hard: Distinguishing a real application failure from setup, configuration or measurement problems.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can question the setup and investigate behaviour outside the expected test sequence.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in research participation or operational control authority.

reach.task: Describe application behaviour with configuration and reproduction context

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and generates reports; that supports evidence capture rather than replacement of automotive application research and testing participation.

assumptions: Boundary is the technician's investigation planning and participation, excluding independent software development, formal application approval and separate report production.

OTHER means the automotive application test environment. In s1 the technician establishes hardware and software versions, interfaces, test scope, conditions, observation channels and limits. Capture and configuration checking remain fully counted.

Application responses and test observations are produced only when the application is exercised in s2; the technician observes and checks them there. No structured expected-behaviour or system-safe flag is assumed.

Unknown configurations or unexplained responses cause manual investigation and engineering escalation. Use existing native test tools; no new process or integration is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Actual application types and laboratory or vehicle test settings
Existing test automation and the technician's residual effort
research_questions: Can measured test participation identify repeated manual handling distinct from setup, investigation and observation?

already_counted.description: Plan and participate in application research or testing

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. A routine application test and an unexplained interface failure both retain full human planning, participation and investigation time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Build special-purpose instrumentation and laboratory equipment

steps.what: Build special-purpose instrumentation or laboratory equipment, fitting and connecting components to the test design
Inspect the built instrumentation and verify connections and intended functions before handing it for review

tasks.design: Keep physical assembly and verification with the technician, using the controlled equipment design in {DOCS}. The checked equipment goes to the responsible engineer for any further acceptance; no software record substitutes for physical connection and function checks.
tasks.previous_blocker: Special-purpose equipment requires adapting physical components to a particular test need.
tasks.enabler_now: The supplied digest does not establish an automated replacement for this physical construction work.
tasks.still_hard: Detecting wiring, mounting and interface problems in a one-off assembly.
tasks.human_edge: The technician can inspect, fit and correct the actual equipment and recognise unexpected interactions.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in physical build effort or final equipment acceptance authority.

reach.task: Explain the actual build configuration and unresolved equipment limitations

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: constructing and checking special-purpose test equipment remains physical technical work; no labour saving is demonstrated by the digest.

assumptions: Boundary is physical equipment construction and the technician's handoff checks, excluding design creation, procurement and independent test-equipment acceptance.

The technician checks component identifiers, design revision, wiring and interface references, mounting, actual build deviations and observed functions during s1 and s2. Capture and physical verification remain fully counted.
There is no assumed structured correctly-built or ready-for-use flag. Missing design detail, uncertain connections or unexpected response require manual correction and engineering clarification.
Use existing native design references and test tools. No new configuration or process is introduced, so incremental upkeep is zero.
unknowns: The technician's permitted build and acceptance remit
research_questions: Is there a repeat build-record burden distinct from physical assembly and verification?

already_counted.description: Build, inspect and verify the special-purpose equipment before handoff

approvals.approved_version: Exact as-built configuration, design reference, checked functions and unresolved limitations before review handoff; changes require rechecking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B100 R100 gives gross0 and net0 with zero upkeep. A straightforward instrumentation assembly and a build with interface problems both retain full physical construction and verification time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Test validity, research participation and special-purpose equipment construction remain fully counted until a distinct repetitive component is measured.
reach: Explain test validity limits and actual equipment configurations
role.ambitious_version: An automotive engineering technician who supplies credible test recommendations, reproducible observations and physically checked laboratory equipment.
